mechanism: Valproic acid may inhibit bupropion metabolism via CYP2D6 inhibition, potentially increasing bupropion levels and seizure risk; bupropion lowers seizure threshold while valproic acid is used for seizure control creating opposing effects.
action: Monitor seizure threshold closely; consider alternative antidepressant; if co-prescribed, use lowest effective bupropion dose and monitor for increased adverse effects.
